svg.title: Four statuses for one entry
svg.text: Every entry lands in one of four boxes under the pack that governs it
the family is one the pack
is one it lists for the function
makes it vulnerable, or the pack
a table places, or the pack
or a protocol version the pack
the slice's 47 entries under OMB M-26-15, measured 2026-11-09; unknown is a count, never a pass
under CNSA 2.0 the same X25519MLKEM768 is not compatible (ML-KEM-1024 only) and SHA-256 is too (SHA-384, SHA-512);
SecP384r1MLKEM1024 is unknown: a hybrid is compliant only where NSA identified one, and none is for TLS
CNSA 2.0 FAQ Ver. 2.2 (October 2026), read first-hand 2026-11-09, every quote checked against its text; no status is provisional
